name: valuva-ai-graphics
description: HTML-based graphics generator for DaVinci Resolve

scripts.build: cd resolve-plugin && npx vite build && echo 'Build complete: check the build folder'
scripts.prepare: cd resolve-plugin && npx svelte-kit sync || echo ''
scripts.check: cd resolve-plugin && npx svelte-kit sync && npx svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.check:watch: cd resolve-plugin && npx svelte-kit sync && npx svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --watch
